result.summary: The page is mostly functional and well laid out, but one data bug stands out: the Smash Bros Burgers delivery fee renders as "€NaN delivery". A couple of minor visual polish issues are also present around the address dropdown indicator and the promotional banner's decorative graphics.

issues.description: The delivery price under "Smash Bros Burgers" displays the literal placeholder text "€NaN delivery" instead of a numeric amount.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery fee is computed or fetched correctly and rendered as a formatted currency value (e.g., "€1.90 delivery"), with a fallback for missing data.

issues.description: The delivery address line shows a downward chevron immediately after "Tallinn" with no spacing, making it look run together with the address text.
issues.suggestion: Add spacing or a distinct touch target styling between the address text and the dropdown chevron.

issues.description: The promotional banner's decorative overlapping translucent circles are clipped unevenly by the banner's rounded corners, producing an awkward hard-edged shape at the right side of the green card.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper overflow clipping (e.g., border-radius on the decorative container) or reduce/adjust the decorative shapes so they blend with the banner edge.
